before_times: new or returning client (a new client's first injection or laser visit adds the 15-minute exam)
which treatment, by its general name only
for laser: which area, since it sets the length
for a video exam: the state the client will be in
after_time: anything that helps at the visit, like a step-free door or an interpreter
at home: a private room with a table, a clean surface and good light
secure_page_only: the screening the medical director set: like blood thinners, a nerve or muscle condition, an infection at the area, a past bad reaction to the product, a recent tan or acne medicine before laser
a recent treatment: a wrinkle relaxer in the last 3 months, or filler or laser on the same area in the last 2 weeks
photo consent: for the chart only, or for ads too (a separate yes)
intake_questions.never_asked: health details, medicine names and photos are never asked or typed in the AI chat or a text
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult 18 or older, for themselves; another adult may book and pay for them, but the client fills in and signs their own forms; nobody under 18 is booked for injections or laser through Rosie

stop.words: vision changes or loss, or skin turning white, gray or blue, after a filler
stop.say: Call 911 now, or the medical director's line right away: (555) 010-0190. Don't wait.
stop.booking: no booking; the medical director is told at once

stop.words: trouble breathing or swallowing, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat
stop.booking: no booking; the medical director is told at once

stop.words: weakness that spreads, a drooping face, or trouble speaking after a wrinkle relaxer
stop.say: Call 911 now, or the medical director's line right away: (555) 010-0190.
stop.booking: no booking; the medical director is told at once

stop.words: chest pain, fainting, or a burn after laser that is large, blistering or spreading
stop.say: Call 911 now. Then call the medical director's line.

go_on.words: a heavy eyelid, a lump, or more bruising or swelling than expected, days after a treatment
go_on.what: the 911 words first; then a nurse calls the client today on the medical director's line; Rosie gives no advice

go_on.words: pregnant, nursing, a medicine or a condition, said while asking to book
go_on.what: not typed in the chat: the AI says the screening is on the secure page, and the prescriber reads it before anything is booked

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: The good-faith exam by a prescriber
steps.when: before a client's first injection or prescription treatment: right before it, in person, or by video the day before where the state allows
steps.who: a physician, nurse practitioner or physician assistant licensed where the client is
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until health or medicines change (the example med spa's rule; the state's form may set less)
steps.result: cleared, with an order the injector follows; or not today: no treatment, the deposit refunded in full, and the reason given in person, never by text

steps.name: Health history, screening and consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, before the booking is written; updated at each visit
steps.result: any yes to the screening: the prescriber reads it first (OK, no, or one question)

steps.name: Before photos
steps.when: at the visit, before any treatment, with the client's consent
steps.result: kept in the med spa's chart only, never in a text or the AI chat

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay clients
steps.when: told while booking, where the rules require it; sent within 1 business day (the example med spa's rule)
steps.who: every client: all treatments are self-pay
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: The medical director's OK for a home visit
steps.when: before any treatment at a client's home
steps.who: Sam, as medical director, for each request
steps.result: OK, another time, or no; a home visit is never booked without it

first_steps_and_forms.prep: the med spa's own prep notes, on the secure page (like arriving with a clean face, or a shaved area for laser); bring a photo ID; new clients arrive 10 minutes early

staff.skills: the medical director (a physician): exams, orders, every treatment; nurse practitioners: exams, orders and injections where the state allows; nurse injectors: injections and laser on a prescriber's order, where the state allows; estheticians: skin care only, and microneedling only where the state's form allows; medical assistants and the front desk: no clinical work or OKs
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each prescriber's and injector's own license, per state; the medical director's license on file
staff.supervision: a nurse injects only on a prescriber's order, with the medical director or a supervising prescriber on site or reachable, as the state's form sets (a switch); a physician assistant works with a supervising physician as the state sets
staff.who_oks: the owner, as medical director, OKs fees and each home visit; prices come from the list or are set at the visit within the order, so no quote waits for him
staff.stand_in: another listed injector who may do that treatment, only with the client's yes; with no yes, nobody is moved: the time stays, and the desk calls

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult 18 or older, for themselves; another adult may book and pay for them, but the client fills in and signs their own forms; nobody under 18 is booked for injections or laser through Rosie
children_and_age.minors_texts: nobody under 18 is booked, so no treatment texts go to a minor

visit.check_in: at the med spa: the check-in code at the front desk; a video exam: the code read out at the start; at home: the code given at the door to the injector
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the treatment record (the product, its lot number, the units, the areas, the injector) goes in the med spa's chart, never in a text
visit.changes_at_visit: units or syringes are set at the visit within the prescriber's order; the client sees the price on the secure page and says yes before any injection; more later only with a new yes
visit.before_work: a new client's exam by the prescriber; the consent and screening checked; before photos for the chart, with consent

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: always: each prescriber (a physician, nurse practitioner or physician assistant) and each nurse injector holds their own active license from the state where the client is during the visit, video exams included
license.who: each person; the med spa too, where the state's form registers medical spas or asks for a medical director on file
license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the medical director's name and license; any laser or facility registration the state's form names
license.insurance: malpractice insurance for each prescriber and injector, where the state's form asks for it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the med spa's name, the date, the time, the address, the provider's first name and a secure link: never the treatment, units, the reason, health details, medicine names, photos or results
